about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: Allen County Commission/Sd #1
channels.legal_basis: K.A.R. 28-16-27: an emergency or accidental discharge of sewage to waters of the state "shall be immediately reported to the state department of health"; a planned bypass needs notice and approval at least seven days ahead

channels.note: No web channel found: Wichita #5-Mid Continent Airport reports an emergency or accidental sewage discharge to KDHE immediately (K.A.R. 28-16-27); KDHE publishes no list (ks-kdhe-district-reports). An overflow becomes public only when KDHE issues a stream advisory (ks-kdhe-stream-advisories). No public notice is required by statute or rule. (research/ks/report.md §2.1)
